title: Eifel beech stand — 360° image from a VR study
description: Near-ground 360° panorama of a beech stand in the Eifel, taken for the study 'Advancing Forest Monitoring and Assessment Through Immersive Virtual Reality' (Wageningen University & Research). Covers the chain's equirectangular input with a real forest panorama from a peer-reviewed study. The image carries NO camera pose and therefore runs through the pass-through branch, not the reprojection — unlike the scanner RGB images, whose pose comes with the E57.

source.dataset: Zürcher, R., Zhao, J., Lau, A., Brede, B., Klippel, A. (2023): Advancing Forest Monitoring and Assessment Through Immersive Virtual Reality. Wageningen University & Research.
source.attribution: Zürcher, R., Zhao, J., Lau, A., Brede, B., Klippel, A. (2023): Advancing Forest Monitoring and Assessment Through Immersive Virtual Reality. Wageningen University & Research.
